component.name: XX Dialer
component.summary: The phone app that knows who is allowed to ring

description.p: A ring-policy dialer for Linux phones: spam never rings, starred contacts always ring, everyone else rings only inside their window. All screening is local and offline; the app makes no network connections.

Recents with per-call verdicts, T9 keypad, People with tier controls, a Rules screen with an Expecting-a-call bypass, Android-compatible backup export/import, and a redacted diagnostics log. Silenced calls leave one batched card with Call back, Ring next time, and Block actions.
Polish: lock-screen handoff contract tests, silenced-call action targets that survive service restarts, atomic contact tag updates, backup export/import, and a redacted logs view.
